faqs.question: What is Open Practice?
faqs.answer: Open Practice is free, non-accredited AI training built around doing: 20 practical build paths, 250 activities and 39 free tools.

faqs.question: Is it really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. No account, no card, no sign-up form; the materials download for offline use and the work stays with the learner.

faqs.question: Do I get a certificate?
faqs.answer: No. Open Practice is non-accredited; what you keep is the work you built and the evidence around it.

faqs.question: Do I need a paid AI subscription?
faqs.answer: No. The activities are built around free tools in the directory.

faqs.question: Can I use it offline?
faqs.answer: Yes, the packs download and work without a connection.

faqs.question: Who is it for?
faqs.answer: People who have watched months of tutorials and still are not sure they could do it alone.

readiness.mechanism: Eight questions, asked at enrolment and again at exit, scored the same way both times, results published as a single movement number per cohort on open-practice-store.pages.dev and in facts.json.
readiness.scoring: Identical eight questions on a fixed self-report scale at both passes, so the difference is measurable movement rather than recall.
